crossRefs.note: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.
The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”
Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”
At this, many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but…
Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax…
The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”
When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”
Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.
These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of…
For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven, and gives life to the world.”
I am the bread of life.
I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread…
This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna, and died. He who eats this bread will…

translations.web: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”
translations.bsb: At this, the Jews began to grumble about Jesus because He had said, “I am the bread that came down from heaven.”
translations.kjv: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
translations.asv: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, I am the bread which came down out of heaven.
